asr.full_text: Have you ever wondered how the right decision can dramatically change your life for the better? And it doesn't matter how old you are, where you live or what you do or how little money you're willing to pay for an attempt to change your life. A student, a warehouse worker, a married couple, a successful businessman and a little-known musician, these people are from the United States, the UK and Europe and other countries. These are all examples of people whose lives have been changed beyond recognition by crypto and most importantly, the door is open. You can become one of them today good education so he was very keen to provide a decent future for his son. To do this the man set a goal to increase his own savings. Rob started reading a lot about cryptocurrencies. One day a new coin, Shiba Inu, caught his attention. Rob decided to take a risk and in February 2021 he invested $8,000 in the coin. Three months later Shiba Inu's value increased 1200 times so his fortune reached more than $9 million. Rob immediately withdrew the first half million from crypto. He later admitted that on the first day, he checked his bank account literally every hour to make sure it wasn't a dream, and even cried when he received the money. This is not surprising, as he was earning $68,000 at his job at the supermarket. It turns out that investing in crypto his salary for a month and a half, he got income for 132 years of work. A few weeks after receiving his crypto income, he quit his job and announced that his main job now was being a father. The 2nd one. Glaubur Contesoto from unknown musician to millionaire in 2 months. Glaubur is a musician from Los Angeles, California, who comes from a middle-class family. Before investing investing in cryptocurrency He invested in shares of Tesla and uber dreaming of getting rich Glauber was looking for a promising token in which to invest successfully That's exactly what he thought dogecoin was the inspiration came from statements made by Elon Musk who? Repeatedly mentioned the currency in his posts on Twitter Contessotto collected all his savings sold the shares he had and even borrowed some of the money. In February 2021, he spent $180,000 to buy Dogecoins. The price of a token at the time was less than half a cent. In just 2 months, the coin had gone up 10 times in price. As a result, Contessoto's balance increased to $1.8 million. In May 2021, the Dogecoin exchange rate soared to a record high of 70 cents and then started falling again. However, the rapid rise of the coin did not cause the investor to want to cash out but in vain. Then came the downturn. In any case the final profit allowed him to multiply his capital fourfold and become a millionaire thanks to crypto. The Third Story The couple who solved the puzzle in the painting, and were rewarded with $135,000 worth of bitcoins. The painting, solved the puzzle in the painting and were rewarded with 135 thousand dollars worth of Bitcoins. The painting where the password to a cryptocurrency wallet containing Bitcoins was encrypted was drawn in 2015 by artist Rob Myers and an anonymous artist known on Twitter as CoinArtist. For three years no one managed to crack the code. People were looking for the password in everything they could except the key which turned out to be the key to the solution. Looking at the picture you can see the ribbons on it. The long ends of which the artist marked as ones and the short ends of zeros. Base 58 a variant of numeric encryption using numbers and Latin letters was used to encrypt the code. In 2018 a 35 year old programmer under the pseudonym Isaac did solve the binary code. He said that Puzzles were a hobby he and his wife shared. They especially liked mysteries related to cryptocurrency even though it is banned in their country. And now the fourth story. A high school student bought crypto and ten years later he's earning over 1.1 million dollars a month An american John Paul Baric acquired bitcoins in 2012 while still in high school. The purchase cost him 1.4 million dollars and he had no idea that the rate would soar that much. A reminder, at the time the value of the coin was in the range from 4 to 14 dollars. In 1213, in English class, Baric was given the task of writing a business plan, and the schoolboy got the idea to create a mining farm, a machine for mining cryptocurrency. John managed to bring his plan to life in 2017. He would buy video cards on eBay and build units in a milk crate in the basement of his house. After a while, Barak decided to expand the business and invited two of his friends to join him. The guys created mining units and sold them online. That's how they managed to earn the first two million dollars then the guys set up a mining farm and hired about 20 employees the number of mining units increased to 1300 and revenue rose to 1.2 million dollars a month after becoming a millionaire john barrick bought the sports car of his dream a lexus rc 350 and started traveling story number number 5 Ty Hutu is the family of a successful entrepreneur who traded all their possessions for crypto to make the money work for them. The characters is business man DDT Hutu from the Netherlands. He is different from previous characters because he had everything several companies, a large house, luxury cars. But after his father died Ty Hutu begu began to think about the meaning of life. The role of money, family values and decided to change his life drastically. He sold all his possessions and invested the money in Bitcoin. The value of 1 coin at the time was 900 dollars. They changed life in the luxurious Taihutu mansion to camping at the time the family was spoken of as odd balls and their action was called a bizarre gamble. When Bitcoin took off, people talked about them again. Thanks to the growth of the crypto market, Taihootu got their fortune back, although they themselves admit that they did not set themselves such a goal. According to D.D., he wanted to change the rules of life and show his loved ones what true happiness is, to see loved ones every day instead of working and being under constant stress, even having money, as D.D. lived before crypto. Today, the amount of monthly expenses of their family is on with friends, crypto helps you save and grow your money. And you don't have to start with large sums and invest all your spare money. You can start with a couple of dollars. If you want to know how, I have prepared a video with detailed instructions for you. I hope it will be useful. And don't forget to subscribe to our channel to get simple and useful videos and learn this tool better.
